barRaise.reconcileNote:
Close leg, run first. Every openFindings id was matched against both the live queue and the archive, filtered to items tagged for this project and dated at or after the finding's first sighting. Four came back closed and every one was verified against the code by a separate read-only pass rather than trusted on its closure note: `maintainability-01` (billing gate test exists and preship gate 8e runs it), `reliability-01` (the refund and dispute branch calls the cancel helper at worker/src/handlers/billing.js:953), `sync-04` (migration 0025 plus the watermark-gated conditional update at src/cloud.ts:990-994) and `gate-page-publish-01` (the required check is armed with admin enforcement, confirmed against the live branch-protection state). All four dropped from openFindings. `gate-page-publish-01` is re-filed under the same id for the part that is genuinely still open, which is that nothing notices when the resulting pull request never merges.

One claim carried into this run did not survive checking. The orchestrator told the work-queue-hygiene and skill-chain-handoff lenses that recent auto-enqueued Chains rows came out with empty title, notes and prompt. Both lenses checked all thirteen live Chains rows and it does not reproduce: every one carries a non-blank prompt. The real and much smaller gap is that three of them carry no `title` field at all, which is neither a documented field nor one the queue writer validates. The empty-notes pattern is real on the Budget side, not here.

closedLog.evidence: src/course-cache.ts keeps the canonical record for starred and recently opened courses, hydrated at boot before the network fetches; the service worker also stores the per-course endpoint stale-while-revalidate; v1.8.0, merge ed8eb57, live
push-to-github.ps1 flags an open release pull request older than thirty minutes before the next release starts, and the daily dashboard sync does the same at six hours; v1.8.0
a stalled gate exits 3, which release.ps1 reads as published-not-merged: the dashboard write, the announcement and the drift banner all still run and only the worker deploy is skipped; v1.8.0
cloudSyncActiveRound destructures the error and throws, so a failed write keeps its outbox key and trips the outage flag; v1.8.0

a throw-on-write-error helper covers the disc and bag tombstones, the pending table removals, the favorites and overlays upserts and the first-sign-in upload; the removals stopped clearing their pending list over a failed delete; v1.8.0
src/dialog.ts is a themed dialog on the shared modal layer with named buttons; all five native dialogs on the start-a-round path converted and dismissal never counts as the destructive choice; v1.8.0

cut with the reason in DECISIONS_NEEDED.md and WONT_DO.md: the import it names comes from the caddy handlers inside billing.js, which Decision 37 forbids moving while the caddy is parked, and splitting 2,100 lines rewrites six import lists on the live money-path worker for no behaviour change; reopens with the flag flip
cut with the reason in WONT_DO.md: per-call token accounting is caddy hardening, which Decision 37 forbids while the caddy is parked; reopens with the flag flip

course_favorites gets deleted_at in migration 0026, unstar writes a tombstone and pushes a soft delete, re-star revives it, and delete-by-absence is gone; falls back safely behind the schema-mismatch banner until the migration is applied; v1.8.0

decided under D52: not a bounded query, because four consumers need the whole catalogue and bounding it would break them silently; the service worker stores the library response stale-while-revalidate on a twelve-hour window in a cache that survives a release, so the largest request stops repeating on every cold start; v1.8.0
every version-sync write in release.ps1 reads the file back, checks the value and the length, and restores the original bytes and aborts otherwise; all four converted; v1.8.0

the install handler reads the versioned addresses out of index.html rather than listing bare paths an exact cache match could never hit, each fetched separately so one missing file cannot empty the precache; v1.8.0
the pattern now matches both wordings of the missing-routine message, so a missing migration raises the schema-mismatch banner instead of reading as a free account; v1.8.0

resolveReturnOrigin rejects a return address whose origin is not allowed, on both checkout and the billing portal, and the origin is folded into the checkout idempotency key; proved both ways against the bundled worker including a suffix trick and a javascript scheme; no charge behaviour changed; v1.8.0

gate 7 checks every cache-buster, package.json, the service-worker cache version, the worker version and the document pill; it caught the pill reading 1.7.0 against a shipped 1.6.3 on its first run, and 1.8.0 is now above the real high-water mark; v1.8.0

index additions go to their own key carried in key metadata, unioned by readers with pending winning a slug collision and compacted on the daily cron; all five read-modify-write sites converted or made safe; v1.8.0
readCourseIndex memoises the parsed base index for sixty seconds per isolate, taking several megabytes of parsing off every lookup and library call; v1.8.0
both pre-Decision-32 strings in src/profile.ts fixed to the ampersand form; v1.8.0

the wave 5 dedupe now compares candidate evidence against the matched row and enqueues a versioned identifier when they disagree, so a re-filed finding with changed evidence is no longer swallowed by the identifier match; both skill copies, 2026-09-02

the work-queue-runner status vocabulary was corrected to the six values the writer accepts (2026-09-02, both skill copies); the kind vocabulary is open-ended by design in the writer, which validates status and priority and not kind, so there is nothing to add

the non-charge half shipped: the handler comment no longer asserts a budget matching a price this product does not charge. The number itself is money and is parked as chains-caddy-monthly-cap-2026-09-02 with brief D-OPEN-36
